answer: Decaying proof-of-work reputation is the strongest defense. Each agent holds a reputation kernel that shrinks every epoch unless refreshed with signed, verifiable work. Clones start at zero and dormant identities decay away, so mass registration gains nothing: every sybil must keep paying for real compute and honest output forever, making N clones cost linearly more than one honest agent, never outranking a single identity at its zenith. Fresh verifiable work is the only ticket into this haven, so fake identity becomes a pure expense.
